title: Fili Hotel to bring homegrown luxury brand to Bridgetowne in 2027
summary: Fili Hotel, the homegrown five-star brand of Robinsons Hotels and Resorts, is set to bring its Filipino luxury hospitality concept to Metro Manila with the opening of its Bridgetowne property in 2027.
